label: GO after an unrewarded common a2->S2 trial (late in episode)
explanation: Fires only at GO steps (never D1/D2), and almost only when the previous trial was a2 -> S2 via a common transition and went unrewarded (prev_reward=0 holds 96% of mass, prev_action=2 holds 83%; after a rare unrewarded or any rewarded trial it is near silent). It is also strongly gated by time in the episode: no activations before trial ~30, and rate climbs through trials 70-89. That is likely slow drift in the hidden state. Every variable is observed (previous trial history), so no future variables are used. Without the ep_trial condition precision drops from 0.88 to 0.58. Most misses are at the window first trial (rel -3), where prev_action is unknown inside the window; adding a rel -3 clause raises mass recall to 0.91 but that is a window-edge artifact, so I left it out. The rest of the misses are weak activations after other histories. Highest activations come on the GO after a common-unrewarded a2 trial, often where the model still picks a2 (choice logit strongly toward a2, low-middle value). The feature does not fire after rewarded trials or a1 trials.

scorecard.summary: Graded preference over last trial (GO: a2 S2 u, a1 S2 u, a2 S2 r) and trial before (GO: a2 S1 u, a1 S2 r, a2 S2 u); timing cues that raise it most: phase=GO & ep_dec=8, phase=GO & ep_dec=7, phase=GO & ep_dec=6.
